title: Rvalues keep copying
summary: A move the compiler does not declare, or declares deleted, is left undeclared, and rvalues keep copying
prose: A declared destructor or copy operation suppresses the implicit moves; a member that cannot move deletes them, and overload resolution then passes over them. Either way an rvalue is copied today. `= delete` would make it fail to compile, and `= default` on a class with a destructor would move members the user's code copied.
